summary: Relax: draw light lines and solve story puzzles for mindful, anti-stress play
description:
Unwind, breathe, and draw the light.

Linea: Anti-Stress Lights is a serene puzzle story that turns your screen into a pocket oasis. ✨

Glide your finger to create one continuous beam of light, solve gentle brain-teasers, and watch heartfelt tales blossom - all while melting away everyday stress.

🌿  Why Linea is your new relaxation ritual

1. Science-backed stress relief: Simple line-drawing mechanics paired with soft haptic feedback and ASMR-style audio calm the nervous system and promote mindfulness.

2. Cozy, bite-sized stories: Each chapter introduces new characters overcoming life’s little hurdles - friendship, hope, love, loss - told through minimalist art and soothing narration.

3. Zen puzzle design: No timers, no pressure. Every puzzle is handcrafted to be challenging enough to engage your mind yet gentle enough to keep you in a flow state.

4. Ambient soundscapes: From forest rain to crackling campfires, dynamic sound layers adapt as you play, helping you relax, focus, or drift into meditation.

5- Play anywhere, anytime: Offline mode, one-hand controls, and quick levels make Linea perfect for a mindful break at home, on your commute, or before sleep.

6. Collect fireflies & keepsakes: Find hidden fireflies to unlock calming keepsakes and deeper lore - little rewards that encourage slow, intentional play.

🧘‍♀️  Built for calm & clarity:
	•	Stress relief & anxiety aid: Designed alongside relaxation experts.
	•	Minimalist aesthetic: Clean lines and pastel palettes reduce visual fatigue.
	•	Adaptive difficulty: The game learns your pace and keeps challenge in the sweet spot.
	•	Family-friendly & ad-light: Share the chill with kids, friends, or grandparents.
	•	Regular “mindful drops”: Free story updates keep fresh content flowing.

How to enjoy your first mindful session
	1.	Put on headphones for full 3D audio immersion.
	2.	Draw a single luminous line to connect the power in the frame.
	3.	Pause anytime - the light patiently waits.
	4.	Feel your shoulders drop as tension fades.

Download Linea: Anti-Stress Lights now and let every line you draw guide you toward calm, clarity, and a lighter heart.
